items.name: ReSO AI
items.tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI
items.description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

items.name: Onepin
items.tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right
items.description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

items.name: Claude Dashboards & Motion
items.tagline: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers
items.description: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

items.name: Microsoft-Decision-1
items.tagline: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows
items.description: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

items.name: Cue
items.tagline: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing
items.description: Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

items.name: Firefox 157
items.tagline: A brand new Firefox is here
items.description: Say hello to a refreshed design and more ways to make it feel like home. Your bookmarks, extensions, and shortcuts are right where you left them.

items.name: Skreno
items.tagline: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser
items.description: Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

items.name: Kitbar
items.tagline: Your dev tools, in one bar.
items.description: A thin bar on the edge of your screen shows how your Vercel deploys, GitHub checks, Stripe payments and Claude Code limits are doing. Point at a ring for the details and act from there. No account, no server; keys stay in your keychain. Mac and Windows.

items.name: Skymir
items.tagline: Google Drive sync for Linux
items.description: Skymir mirrors your Google Drive folders to Linux with two-way sync, double-click Google Docs shortcuts, and a native GTK tray. Local saves upload within seconds; changes made in Drive arrive within about a minute. Deletes go to the trash on both sides, and a sync that would delete more than half your files is refused. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial, no subscription.

items.name: Maildun for Mac
items.tagline: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP
items.description: Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

items.name: Lune
items.tagline: The search engine built for scientific AI agents
items.description: Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

items.name: TapNoise
items.tagline: A tiny desktop pet that reacts to every key you press
items.description: Meet Tappy, a little keycap who lives on your Mac's desktop. Tappy sweats when you type fast, gets dizzy when you slap your MacBook, eats when the charger goes in and naps when you're away. Coding with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor? Tappy chimes when your agent is done and sweats until you knock twice on your MacBook to answer. Plus 20 keyboard sounds, a lift alarm for café tables and Clean Mode for wiping the keys. Pay once, no subscription.

items.name: GitGlow
items.tagline: Review your code and your agents' changes before you ship
items.description: GitGlow brings precise staging, clear history, and a checkout-aware terminal into one local Git workspace. Pro adds review marks and checks that become stale after edits, plus managed agent and release tools. Free for private local clones; no account needed.

items.name: API Claws by Buda
items.tagline: Build self-improving agent harness with one API
items.description: API Claws is Buda's developer-facing Agent API. Create hosted AI agents with Drive memory, model routing, managed runtime, observability, sessions, and embeddable product experiences, without building the full agent infrastructure yourself.

items.name: New Windows Search
items.tagline: Windows Search now takes action, not just finds files
items.description: Microsoft is rebuilding Windows Search to help you do things, not just find them. The new experience is faster, cleaner, and lets you take action directly from the search box. Switch to dark mode, toggle Bluetooth, adjust brightness, mute your PC, or arrange windows simply by typing what you need. Built on WinUI 3 with improved search relevance, it's rolling out to Windows Insiders first, with richer previews and more actions on the way.

items.name: History Monk
items.tagline: Fast History Search, Export & Bulk Delete
items.description: History Monk replaces your browser's history page. Type a few letters and the page you want shows up. Filter by site, day or hour, see where your time goes, and clear out the clutter. 100% local and private.

items.name: Hypervibe
items.tagline: Run your AI coding agents on one infinite board
items.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents side by side on an infinite board. Hypervibe brings real terminals, agent status, teams, voice control and live previews into one native Mac app. Use the agent accounts you already have. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

items.name: Fluence
items.tagline: Listen to your documents. Nothing leaves your phone
items.description: Fluence. reads your PDFs, EPUBs, Word, OpenDocument, Rich Text and Markdown files aloud — in a natural voice that ships inside the app, in 31 languages, with nothing to download first. Follow the highlighted text as it plays, ask the document a question and get an answer drawn from its own passages, or record your own voice and have it read back to you. No account, no server, no subscription: one payment, and it works offline for good.

items.name: put·here
items.tagline: A place to collect notes to organize them later
items.description: Most note apps want an answer the moment you save something: a title, a folder, a tag. Ideas show up before they have a shape. put·here is a canvas for the Mac where text, links, pictures and files land wherever you drop them — paste, drag, or press ⌃⌥P from any app. Step back and the whole canvas reads at a glance. Every canvas is a real folder of plain files on your Mac, so your notes stay yours. Free to start.

items.name: Pawse
items.tagline: A cute 3D pet that reminds you to drink water & take breaks
items.description: Pawse is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app. A cute 3D pet walks onto your screen to remind you to drink water, keep habits like stretching every 30 minutes, and take screen-time breaks, with an optional hard block.
